name: How long does an open-concept kitchen remodel typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an open-concept kitchen remodel typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an open-concept kitchen remodel varies based on the scope of work, including structural changes like wall removal, plumbing, and electrical reconfigurations. Generally, a complete remodel can take anywhere from 8 to 16 weeks from demolition to final touches. This timeline includes planning, obtaining permits, demolition, construction, installation of new fixtures, and finishing work. Unexpected issues can sometimes extend the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: An open-concept kitchen remodel typically takes 8 to 16 weeks, depending on the scope and structural changes involved.
